authority.alpha_prerequisite: Keep the POA&M as the concise lifecycle ledger for verified gaps while routing implementation detail, current evidence, and remediation history to their canonical linked owners.

current_behavior: The refactored POA&M parent is a 41-line ledger with 27 coordinated child records, but its heading calls all entries open even though three are closed. All 27 Owning gates sections contain plain text and no roadmap warp. POAM-011 is still a 166-line mini-authority that repeats shared protocol, six SDK, Connectome, packaging, and closure detail already owned by existing reference records. POAM-014 directs future gates to update one global prose trace instead of the package-local active plan and journal. POAM-027 still says the procedure-to-diff binding is not machine-readable even though POAM-027a implemented check_change_plan.py and candidate CI invokes it; POAM-011 and POAM-027 also retain dated convergence history in their live deficiency bodies.
target_behavior: Retain exactly one parent-owned row for each POAM-001 through POAM-027 with the same priority and lifecycle status, under an accurate deficiency-ledger heading. Give every child a direct link to each relevant roadmap gate-family owner. Make POAM-011 a concise observed-gap, impact, owner-warp, and closure record that links the existing executable public-contract, six language SDK, Connectome, Gate H, and evidence owners instead of copying them. Make POAM-014 preserve A-07 as a frozen discovery baseline while requiring each bounded package to carry its exact trace in the active plan and linked journal, with the generated inventory as the current-path projection. Make POAM-027 state the implemented local/candidate-CI validator accurately, link the POAM-027a/b/c journals, and leave only automatic fact derivation plus eligible server-side enforcement as the live gap. Extend documentation policy with bounded topology, section, owner-link, and stale-authority checks without prescribing a schema of thought or fixing mutable status values.
unchanged_behavior: README.md remains the product identity and current-status owner; the alpha objective owns outcomes; the roadmap owns dependency order and completion evidence; the POA&M parent owns deficiency priority and lifecycle status.

All 27 POA&M identifiers, priorities, statuses, titles, coordinates, and parent ownership remain unchanged; no roadmap checkbox, count, active executable package, version, release, remote, or promotion state changes.
No runtime, protocol, operation catalogue, generated binding, SDK implementation, Connectome implementation, dependency, build artifact, or installed behavior changes.
The policy validates durable documentation ownership and navigation only; exploratory reading, hypothesis formation, context selection, and private model reasoning remain adaptive under ADR-0002.

stop_conditions: Any POA&M identifier, priority, status, title, coordinate, ordering, parent owner, roadmap completion state, product version, runtime behavior, release state, remote, or promotion state changes.
